syntax.7.0: ball cfd history [name <s>] ball cfd keyword ...
syntax.9.0: ball cfd history [name <s>] ball cfd keyword ...

keywords.name: force
keywords.description: Magnitude of the force resulting from fluid interactions.

keywords.name: xforce
keywords.description: The x-component of the force resulting from fluid interactions.

keywords.name: yforce
keywords.description: The y-component of the force resulting from fluid interactions.

keywords.name: zforce
keywords.description: The z-component of the force resulting from fluid interactions.

keywords.name: extra
keywords.description: Take a history of an extra variable. Use index to specify the extra index and type to specify the type.

keywords.name: id
keywords.description: Take the history of the CFD ball with this ID.

keywords.name: position
keywords.description: Take the history of the CFD ball closest to this position.

examples.command: ball cfd history ball cfd force id 1
examples.description: Track the fluid force on ball 1 (7.0/9.0 form)

notes: On 7.00 and 9.8 the quantity must be prefixed by 'ball cfd' ('ball cfd history ball cfd force id 1'); the bare quantity form shown in the manuals is rejected ('Expected tokens: Keywords: ball name'). On 6.00 the bare form works and the prefixed form is rejected.
verification: Live-verified 2026-11-09 on PFC3D 6.00, 7.00 and 9.8 consoles (syntax grade): on 6.00 force/xforce histories created by id, position and name with the bare quantity; on 7.00 and 9.8 created via the 'ball cfd' prefixed form, with the engine enumerating extra, force, xforce, yforce and zforce as the quantities.
